thread:
sandra: Heads-up: onboarding tenant 'Orion' is intermittently failing SSO flows + SCIM writes. Opening thread.
jen: Error samples?
sandra: Two classes: SAML assertion audience mismatch for some users (401 during login) and SCIM PATCH failing with KMS decrypt errors for extId.
tom: Saw this at 07:46 UTC, repeated around 08:12 and 08:40. stack traces show 'aud claim did not match allowed-entity' from oidc-verifier.
vault-bot: [07:46:12] kms.decrypt failed key=orion-extid reason=InvalidEnvelopeHeader request=req_9c7b
jen: Audience issue could be IdP sending spEntityID different than what we expect. Do we have recent changes to allowed-aud list?
sandra: No config deploys. Orion claims they updated their SSO metadata during maintenance. They swapped SP EntityID from https://orion.app/sso to https://orion.app/.
tom: Our OIDC/SAML acceptor compares exact string. We should allow canonicalization for trailing slash. Small but common.
jen: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add tolerant-audience-mode flag for Orion tenant. Can we do toggle-by-tenant?
ops: I can add tenant override: ``/ops tenant-config set orion tolerate_aud true --expires 24h``
sec-oncall: That reduces failures but we need audit entry for the relaxation. Add logging event: AUTH.TOLERATED_AUD with who/why.
vault-bot: [08:05:01] audit.log event=AUTH.TOLERATED_AUD tenant=orion actor=ops reason=temporary-mapping
sandra: KMS decrypt errors: logs show header had "provider":"aws-kms-v2" which we don't support; we expect "redwood-kms-v1" envelope.
jen: We should never accept unknown envelope silently. Circuit: respond 400 with guidance + record detailed audit for SOC. Open SEC-2002.
tom: Also worth adding a compatibility shim to detect aws-kms-v2 and return explicit text: "please wrap with redwood-kms-v1 or contact integrations" so partners know quickly.
ops: For immediate, I'll add a 400 with friendly message and increment metric scim.extid.decrypt_fail.
jen: Longer term: add a validator that lists allowed envelope keys and tests during partner onboarding. SEC-2003.
sandra: I've DM'd Orion integrator for a rewrap and new metadata. They responded: "metadata update included canonicalization change via our templating engine, and some automation re-enveloped extId with provider lib v2 accidentally."
sec-oncall: Action items: (1) ops: enable tolerate_aud for orion (temp) (2) jen: add tolerant-aud canonicalization code + tests (SEC-2004) (3) vault team: add clear 400 + audit for unknown envelope (SEC-2002) (4) integrations: follow up with Orion to resend wrapped extIds + confirm metadata (sandra).
tom: ETA: tolerate flag on in 5m, validator 1d, parser fix 3d. I'll watch auth error rates.
ops: Feature set for Orion done. auth.failures for aud drop from 24->3 in 20m. scim.decrypt_fail metric unchanged until Orion resends.
vault-bot: [09:02:09] scim.create succeeded user=orion/alice request=req_f2a3 note=extid-wrapped-ok
sandra: Good. Will compile incident notes and link SEC tickets. Postmortem later this week. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
